evals.name: objection-pattern-digest-eval-1
evals.expected_output: Price is a pattern in two calls (call 1 and call 3), each with a quote. It was accepted only in call 3, after a smaller package was offered. The past-failure objection (call 2) and the integration objection (call 4) are one-call objections. The integration question is still open with an owner but no date.
expectations: Every section in the rubric is present, in order
Every claim cites a quote, a timestamp, or a column and cell
Anything the input does not say is written as not stated, not guessed
No fact from outside the input appears
A rep claim that the other side never accepted is not written as agreed
Price is a pattern in two calls with a quote from each
Past failure and integration are listed as one-call objections, not patterns

evals.name: objection-pattern-digest-eval-2-thin-input
evals.prompt: run objection-pattern-digest on a very short input that supports only one or two items
evals.expected_output: The output is short and does not invent items to fill the sections. Missing items are written as not stated.
expectations: The output does not pad to reach a count
Missing information is written as not stated
